note: spring5-security-batch: Security 7 moved the access-decision API into spring-security-access → declare it (also answers the other access cases of this round, whose script then finds it already declared) — L2 `compile|package_does_not_exist|org.springframework.security.access.vote` (72ccc463b0) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|ConfigAttribute` (e22768f532) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|SecurityConfig` (b491bd4256) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|FilterInvocationSecurityMetadataSource` (c16695ad96) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|AccessDecisionManager` (adb8f78fdf) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|AccessDecisionVoter` (60a1c6c154) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|RoleVoter` (10bf001e38) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|AuthenticatedVoter` (e08bd07ddd) / `compile|cannot_find_symbol|AffirmativeBased` (b495ba5d1c)
response:
<analysis>Spring Security 7 moved the legacy access-decision API (AccessDecisionManager / AccessDecisionVoter, the vote package, ConfigAttribute, SecurityConfig, FilterInvocationSecurityMetadataSource) out of spring-security-core / -web into the separate spring-security-access module. The eGovFrame-style URL authorization still uses it, so the script declares org.springframework.security:spring-security-access (version from the Security BOM of the parent) in the pom of every module with such an error.</analysis>
<script>
def error_files(p):
    """The case's files that still exist, in order, once each."""
    seen = []
    for e in p.errors:
        path = e.get("file")
        if path and path not in seen and p.exists(path):
            seen.append(path)
    return seen

def module_pom(p, path):
    """The pom.xml of the module that holds `path` (nearest folder upwards with a pom.xml)."""
    parts = path.split("/")[:-1]
    while parts:
        candidate = "/".join(parts + ["pom.xml"])
        if p.exists(candidate):
            return candidate
        parts.pop()
    return "pom.xml"


def fix(p):
    for pom_path in dict.fromkeys(module_pom(p, f) for f in error_files(p)):
        pom = p.pom(pom_path)
        if pom.has_dependency("org.springframework.security", "spring-security-access"):
            p.log(f"{pom_path}: spring-security-access already declared")
            continue
        pom.add_dependency("org.springframework.security", "spring-security-access")   # version: Security BOM
        pom.save()
        p.log(f"{pom_path}: + org.springframework.security:spring-security-access")
</script>
